discovery_query: rank of a generalized Moore matrix and finite etale torsion obstruction pairing for deformations of one-dimensional formal p-divisible groups

matrix.entries: at most 256 rows, entries canonical residues in [0,prime)
matrix.columns: explicit common row length, from 1 to 256

output_contract.rank: exact nonnegative rank over the specified prime field

capability_mismatch: A bounded prime-field matrix-rank operation cannot certify a universal analytic Jacobian or a p-divisible-group deformation theorem. The requested operation checks only the characteristic-two Frobenius projection on F_2[epsilon]/epsilon^2.
mathematical_use: Auxiliary finite sanity check only; not support for det(M) != 0.
